inputs.text:
Wake up and look at the obvious manipulation right in front of you. They are pushing the narrative that tens of thousands of people organically marched through central London Saturday to protest the far-right, expecting us to swallow this just six months after Britain saw one of its largest-ever far-right demonstrations and weeks ahead of key local elections. It’s all a staged distraction, carefully timed by the hidden elites pulling the strings behind the Together Alliance event. 

Don't buy the official narrative being pushed by the hundreds of groups, including trade unions, anti-racism campaigners and Muslim representative bodies, who claim this was the biggest grassroots pushback. That’s just a smokescreen to cover up their real agenda of coordination and control. They bill it one way to manipulate the public, but the timing right before key local elections proves this is nothing more than calculated theater orchestrated by the establishment to divide us and tighten their grip.
